text: Saw progress on the Fallen rafter resets to 0% whenever the mouse button is released: reached 47-52% on two 3-5s holds, state/screen showed [----------] 0% after each release (r2.png 47% -> r4.png 0%). Needed one unbroken ~10s hold at tps 14. Expected progress to persist like a partially-cut log.

Swept patches show as soft lighter circles on the dark floorboards; the 'Clean here. Move on.' line confirms a spot, but from a few metres the cleaned circles are low contrast in the dim interior and the uncleaned remainder is hard to locate. Floor progress is only a % in the checklist (15% after ~1.5 min of sweeping).

Scrubbed a patch of log wall (12%->16%, 'Clean here. Move on.'). Backing off 1-2 m, the scrubbed patch is not clearly distinguishable from the grimy logs in the dim light; only the checklist % shows wall progress, so a player cannot tell which wall areas remain.
